items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: And a few Jerry Lauren Morton tunes, Clarence Williams. ... All the King Oliver tunes I like, all of them. And many more tunes, too, and Clarence Williams. They are the base of my tunes, or repertoire in French.

ctx.x: Did you play first trumpet or second trumpet with Luther? First, usually. First, usually. And that was King Oliver's part? Yes. I see. And what tunes did you play when you began with Luther? Yes.

I was very... cocktail at the beginning because we didn't know many tunes. But by the time we included more and more King Oliver tunes. And a few Jerry Lauren Morton tunes, Clarence Williams. And that's all. What's your favorite tune? Oh, King Oliver, of course.
He's your favorite trumpet player today?
